scope: Current stem, five options and solution were independently read. Ordinary grouping into benches of capacity five, exactly three unused benches, and the explicit minimum/maximum target jointly establish ceil(N/5)=x-3. This is equivalent to 5(x-4)<N<=5(x-3), and integer population gives the existing second option.
caveat: This does not claim the wording expressly rules out every formalistic reading in which all used benches must be full. The judgment relies on the normal grouping interpretation supported by the stated minimum/maximum task.
